entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the UE to request establishment of a secure connection to the network for user data transfer or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by the UE to initiate the service request procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state indicating that the UE is registered with the 5G network.

entities.name: UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state
entities.description: Precondition for initiating the service request procedure.

Service request procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Condition checks if UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
